content: Currently if you navigate to https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib, it redirects to https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib3. Is it not possible to have it go directly to https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4?

The redirect is probably because mathlib was renamed to mathlib3.
I think that to make it point to mathlib4 we'd have to rename mathlib4 to mathlib and then back to mathlib4.
Alternatively if we create an empty mathlib repo and then delete it, the redirect should go away.
The reason this has not been done is that it would break existing links to mathlib3 material (e.g., on Zulip or elsewhere on the web).
Note that https://github.com/leanprover/lean also redirects to the archived https://github.com/leanprover/lean3 (likely for the same reason).

If it was just a matter of a few web / zulip links there might be a chance that we could eventually make /mathlib redirect to /mathlib4, but there are also published papers linking to mathlib3 PRs and commits which we're unlikely to be able to ever update.

I think Eric mentioned this at the time but another option would be to put a copy of Mathlib3 in the Mathlib4 repo (even if it was a separate root commit) and then to do the rename, and then all links should still work unless they're to some random Mathlib3 non-main branch.
